name: BonnBeetClouds3D: 3D Point Cloud Organ-Level Sugar Beet Phenotyping
description: BonnBeetClouds3D is an open-access 3D point cloud dataset for organ-level plant phenotyping and semantic segmentation of sugar beet crops under real field conditions, developed by the Photogrammetry and Robotics Lab at the University of Bonn (PhenoRob Cluster of Excellence). Reconstructed from high-resolution multi-view UAV photogrammetry across 48 breeding plots and multiple growth stages (BBCH 12 to 39), the dataset features dense 3D point clouds with fine-grained semantic annotations for individual plant organs (leaves, stems, soil) and leaf instance IDs alongside physical trait measurements.
